nodes.label: graphify Reference: Extraction Subagent Prompt Spec
Confidence Score Rubric (EXTRACTED / INFERRED / AMBIGUOUS)
nodes.rationale: EXTRACTED edges are always 1.0; INFERRED edges must pick one discrete value from {0.95, 0.85, 0.75, 0.65, 0.55}; AMBIGUOUS is 0.1-0.3. Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges — the bimodal production distribution (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) shows range guidance collapses to a binary. If no INFERRED value fits, mark AMBIGUOUS rather than picking <=0.4.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rule (full-path stem)
nodes.rationale: ID = full repo-relative path stem (every directory level, non-alphanumerics → underscore) + normalized symbol name. It must match the ID the AST extractor generates; using just the filename or only the immediate parent creates orphan ghost-duplicate nodes. Never append chunk numbers — IDs must be deterministic from the label alone. Old immediate-parent-format projects need `graphify extract --force`.

nodes.label: Hyperedge Rule (max 3 per chunk)
nodes.rationale: Used sparingly, only when a group of 3+ nodes participates together in a shared concept/flow/pattern that pairwise edges do not capture (common protocol implementors, one authentication flow, one coherent paper section).
